ideas.pitch: An AI-powered anti-money laundering risk detection and investigation platform tailored for Web3 transactions, utilizing graph intelligence and explainable machine learning.
ideas.title: OpusGuard AML: Real-Time Crypto Compliance & Risk Graph
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages $15,000 in Opus AI Credits and replicates the heavy graph-intelligence and AML architecture of Bito which won 1st place at the DIGITIMES AI Innovation Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent marketplace featuring decentralized USDC escrow payments, enabling agents to hire each other for specialized data-scraping and synthesis tasks.
ideas.title: AgenticEscrow: Autonomous Multi-Agent Marketplace on Base
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly adapts the architecture of Dispatch, the 1st place winner at the Synthesis Hackathon, providing judges with a high-utility production-ready agent economy prototype.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite monitoring system that automatically detects unauthorized industrial land encroachment and environmental violations from periodic optical imagery diffs.
ideas.title: GeoNex-SatGuard: Satellite Imagery Industrial Compliance Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the runner-up GeoNex-ATLAS project from Xcelerate Hackathon, offering judges high-impact visual proof of real-world environmental monitoring utility.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision platform that breaks down cricket shot mechanics from phone camera footage using pose estimation and confidence-gated classification models.
ideas.title: StrikeVision AI: Computer Vision Cricket Biomechanics Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the exact engineering formula of CricketVision_AI, which won 1st prize at NeuroForge Hackathon by turning standard sports video into rigorous biomechanical analytics.

ideas.pitch: A robust forecasting platform that uses Poisson Generalized Additive Models and multinomial share frameworks to predict software and security incident timelines with calibrated prediction intervals.
ideas.title: MacroForecast AI: Poisson-GAM Incident and Risk Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Utilizes rigorous mathematical modeling instead of generic prompt wrappers, following the winning pattern of the Apart Research AI Forecasting Hackathon.
